features.description: Chest pain category recorded at presentation (original UCI 1–4 coding).

features.description: Resting electrocardiographic findings (UCI coding: 0 = normal, 1 = ST-T abnormality, 2 = probable/definite LVH).

features.description: Slope of the peak-exercise ST segment (UCI coding: 1 = upsloping, 2 = flat, 3 = downsloping).

preprocessing.categorical_imputation: most frequent (fitted on training folds only)
preprocessing.categorical_encoding: OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown='ignore'); one reference level per feature

feature_schema.encoding_notes: Uses the original UCI Cleveland codes, not the modified Kaggle encodings: cp 1–4, restecg 0–2, slope 1–3, thal 3/6/7, and num 0–4 mapped to binary via num > 0.

selection.rationale: Logistic Regression had the highest mean 5-fold CV F1 (0.830 ± 0.026) and positive-class recall of 0.792. F1 balances positive-class recall against false positives, while ROC-AUC served as a tie-breaker. The held-out test set was not used for model or hyperparameter selection.
selection.selection_protocol: Hyperparameters were tuned with 5-fold stratified GridSearchCV using ROC-AUC. All models were then scored with the same 5-fold splits on the training partition. The final model was chosen by mean CV F1, then evaluated once on the untouched stratified 20% holdout.

comparison.label: Logistic Regression
comparison.description: Linear baseline on log-odds. Fast, stable and interpretable; coefficients can be inspected per transformed feature.

comparison.label: Random Forest
comparison.description: Bagged ensemble of decision trees. Captures non-linear effects and interactions while averaging away some single-tree variance.

comparison.label: Decision Tree
comparison.description: A single interpretable tree. Useful as a transparent comparison but more prone to overfitting than the ensemble alternatives.

calibration.note: Reliability is estimated from only 61 held-out patients. Bin-level points are unstable and the score is not a clinically calibrated risk.

coefficient_analysis.note: Coefficients are in log-odds units on the transformed (scaled or one-hot) feature space. A term's coefficient is not a causal effect.

dataset_info.name: UCI Heart Disease — Cleveland
dataset_info.positive_class_definition: num > 0: >50% diameter narrowing in at least one major vessel. This is presence of angiographic disease, not future risk.

limitations: Only 303 records from a single 1980s Cleveland cohort; results may not generalise.
The target reflects angiographic disease presence, not future heart-disease risk.
The small 61-patient holdout makes metrics, especially calibration, uncertain.
The 0.5 decision threshold is a default and was not selected for clinical utility.
No external or temporal validation was performed.
Probability outputs are model scores and have not been clinically calibrated.
model_info.intended_use: Academic demonstration of a supervised classification workflow. Not a medical device and not validated for clinical decision-making.
